aliases: Ruggedized Add-On Wired IP 4K 12MP Deterrence Dome Camera
features: add-on for Night Owl FTN8/BTN8/AN12 recorder (not standalone)
release_notes: Night Owl CAM-FTN12-MT-B: a ruggedized wired PoE 12MP (4K+) deterrence dome camera with spotlights, siren, and two-way audio; add-on for a compatible Night Owl recorder. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor inferred.

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).
